ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips and medial scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling and contiguous blobs concentrated at the outer distal margins of both lobes. Distinct light-pixel clusters located on the left lobe tip and right lobe tip, contrasting sharply against the uniform low-intensity dark central body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow pixel-depth; vertex angle approximately 25 degrees relative to the horizontal plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; pixel-amplitude variations along the trailing edge create a jagged profile with multiple peaks and troughs, most pronounced on the mid-to-outer margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lower sweep transitioning to a concave trajectory toward the distal tips, resulting in an upward-tapered geometric termination on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (rosette scars) distributed across the lower central region and the right lobe, appearing as white 'halos' on a dark background.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct linear, non-parallel white pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the right lobe, particularly near the median notch, cutting across the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization visible as high-relief, irregular geometric clusters on the leading outer edges/tips of both lobes; physical trauma scars visible as distinct white circles on the lower-center surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive cluster of perfectly circular white ring-scars concentrated near the bottom-center margin of the fluke.
